run_pipeline_wan_vace: run the WanVACEPipeline to generate a video from first and last frame with a text prompt
encode_prompt_wan_vace: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings for the WanVACE video generation pipeline
preprocess_conditions_wan_vace: preprocess video frames, masks, and reference images for conditioning in the WanVACE pipeline
prepare_video_latents_wan_vace: encode video frames and reference images into latent representations using the Wan VAE
test_pipeline_wan_vace: test the WanVACEPipeline __call__ method with video, mask, prompt, and reference image inputs
